bio: Andre Astono is the founder of Goodfellows Barbershop, a Surabaya grooming brand. He is known for building the business around consistent service and a distinct brand identity.

A. Ditya Wardhana is the co-founder and COO of Kopi Titik Koma, where he oversees operations for the Indonesian coffee business. He brings an industrial-organizational psychology background to the company and is a public voice on coffee entrepreneurship.

Samuel Lie is the owner of Common Grounds Surabaya and is associated with the Common Grounds East Java operation. His professional background also includes KRUI Artisan Bakery, and he studied at Universitas Ciputra Surabaya.

Jimmy Carlos Simamora is a Channel Manager at Huawei Indonesia, focused on strategic partnerships and channel ecosystem growth. He brings more than a decade of technology-sector experience across business development and product management, including prior roles at Samsung and Targus.

Guritno Wirandoko is Sustainability Manager at PT Suparma Tbk, the Indonesian paper manufacturer he joined in 2009. His career at the company spans production and sustainability, and he represents its environmental work in industry forums on efficiency and carbon neutrality.

Dr. Agus Windharto, DEA, is an ITS academic and design-innovation practitioner affiliated with its Center for Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technology. His work spans product design, including apparel, furniture, appliances and transportation, and his recorded intellectual-property work includes an urban luxury electric scooter.
Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Certified AI Consultant and Founder of Zero One and PrivGate.ai.

Abibayu Gustri Kamadjaja is a content creator, entrepreneur and Vice President of Social Bread Enterprise. He leads work for corporate and brand social-media needs, including campaigns, KOL management and social-commerce activity, while maintaining a sizeable public creator presence.

Winona Araminta is a Jakarta-based storyteller and content creator known online as @kamusnana. Her audience spans Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, where she publishes lifestyle and personal-storytelling content; she also works as a freelance strategist.

Enos Aditya Saputra is the Creative Director of Beast Studio, a Surabaya-based creative agency and production house. An entrepreneur and brand strategist with more than 12 years of experience, he has also delivered digital-marketing training for SMEs in collaboration with Universitas Airlangga.

Timothy Rubino is the founder of KOKOMOBIL and an entrepreneur also associated with Quicklin. Based in Surabaya, he shares business, entrepreneurship and personal-development content across his public channels.

Ferry Siswadi, SE, is Director of Bu Rudy Group and owner of Urban Escape Arena in Surabaya. The son of culinary entrepreneur Bu Rudy, he developed Urban Escape as a covered padel and sports venue intended to function as a community destination.
Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, CEO and Managing Partner of wiseco.id.

Jiewa Vieri is the founder of INIJIE Food & Travel and INIJIE Academy, with 17 years of experience in social media and entrepreneurship. A food reviewer, blogger and photographer, he won the 2009 Pesta Blogger Award and continues to work in influencer marketing and photography services.

Stefani Angelia, known as Cinfung, is an entrepreneur and content creator who founded The Overtee, The Overtee Kids, Doesoen Roti and Kwakkie. A mother of three, she is recognized for combining family-centered storytelling and personal branding with consumer-brand building.
Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Co-Founder of GIN.

Abraham Setiawan is CEO of Bie Hin Tailor and carries forward the Surabaya tailoring house's multigenerational craft legacy. He joined the business in 2012 and has led its modernization while maintaining its custom-suit focus.

Andrew Wijaya is a fourth-generation successor and Director of Sumberyala Group. He oversees three group companies spanning seafood processing, vannamei shrimp operations and related aquaculture businesses.

Perry Angglishartono is Product Group Manager at PT Jamu Iboe Jaya, where he has helped position traditional jamu for contemporary consumers. He has represented the company in efforts such as the Jamu Iboe Herbal Bar and product initiatives that combine spices, vegetables and fruit.
Nareswari Lila is a Surabaya media personality, MC, host, moderator and content creator. With more than 14 years in media, she is also known as a morning radio announcer at Gen 103.1 FM Surabaya.

Nathan Santoso is the CEO of IWAK ARUMERY, a Surabaya-based arak brand, and founder of Punggawa Budaya Nusantara. He is a prominent advocate for understanding arak as a culturally significant Indonesian spirit rather than merely a party drink.

Alamanda is a Surabaya multidisciplinary cultural worker and artworker at artchemist.id, working across visual art, exhibitions, radio and independent art media. She also develops cultural programs, collaborates with artists and institutions, and contributes as a discussion moderator and community-based creative educator.

Karin Binanto is CEO of Karbs, Kkado and WKM Concepts, and a creative curator working across hospitality, lifestyle and food. She is behind brands including KKado Chicken, Karbs Bakery, Binh Binh Viet and Yong Luck, several of which were launched during the pandemic.
Speaker at IdeaFest SUB 2026, Head of Brand Development and Strategist.

Deby P. Dewi is Managing Director of Orasis Art Space in Surabaya and an art professional whose practice began with the founding of Color Art Studio in 1998. She leads Orasis initiatives including Surabaya Art and advocates for art spaces as places for learning, dialogue and cultural participation.
